name: Otokar Arma
armament: Remote or manned turret options: 7.62/12.7/14.5 mm MG, 40 mm AGL or 30 mm cannon
protection: Monocoque steel hull, amphibious. Game: immune to 5.56/5.45/7.62x39/7.62x51; 7.62x54R and larger can penetrate side/rear and disable wheels, engine and optics; every launcher in the game list penetrates.
visual_notes: Tall slab-sided 6x6 box hull with three evenly spaced axles and large single tyres
Sloped nose with small driver windows; two propellers under the rear for swimming
Remote weapon station on the roof; large rear ramp/door
